_comment: FROZEN baseline of pre-existing storage-port traits DEFINED in adapter crates, captured by the cloud-ci-port-placement gate (ADR-0570) on the dev tip 2bc9520a5 (after #116/#802 fixed billing's AccountingJournalStoragePort), extended 2026-06-22 to cover adapter-NAMED crates caught by the forbidden_crate_name_suffixes broadening (FIX 1). Born-advisory + enforce-no-regression: these are allowed (ratchet-down only); a NEW port-suffix trait defined in an adapter crate beyond this set fails CLOSED. Relocating any of these into its capability's core/ports crate (mirror #802) self-cleans here via PP-STALE-BASELINE. Their relocation is OUT OF SCOPE for #117 (per the slice's scope discipline: 'Do NOT retrofit other capabilities ports'); each is its own follow-up. The gate flips to fully blocking when this baseline reaches 0. Keys are {member_path: <repo-relative crate dir>, trait: <pub trait name>} — keyed on the full path (not the crate-name tail) to prevent false-GREEN masking when two sibling crates share the same tail. This file is the gate's DATA input — hand-frozen for v1 and committed as plain port-placement-baseline.json (NOT a producer-emitted *.generated.json face, which the repo .gitignore excludes; mirrors the tier-dependency-acyclicity-baseline.json convention). Auto-emitting this baseline from the accounting producer is a noted follow-up (see PR body).
